newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Sidor sale seen in September-Petkoff.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Sidor sale seen in September-Petkoff.

text.p: Venezuela plans to sell off state steel company Sidor in September and its four-company aluminum sector in December, Planning Minister Teodoro Petkoff said Tuesday.

"The contracts are already in Congress. The Sidor auction could take place in September and probably in December for the aluminum sector. That's the timetable we are working with," Petkoff told Union Radio in an interview.
The government submitted the proposed contract to Congress last week for the sale of aluminum smelters Venalum and Alcasa, bauxite producer Bauxilum and carbon anode producer Carbonorca.
The contract for the Sidor sale was handed to Congress in May.
Eleven companies from Mexico, Brazil, Japan, South Korea, Argentina and Venezuela have already qualified to bid for the 1.8 million tonne per year capacity steel company.
Thirteen companies have qualified to bid for the aluminum companies, including Alcoa, Gencor, Alumax, Reynolds Metals Co, Norsk Hydro ASA and RTZ Corp.
